Name: Adult Leech
Description: Wanders around the room, quickly charging at Isaac when he lines up horizontally with him and releasing a ring of blood shots upon colliding with a wall. After taking a certain amount of damage, burrows into the ground and reappears by falling above Isaac, releasing another ring of blood shots and only performing this behavior once.

Name: Angelic Baby
Description: Slowly floats towards Isaac and fires three spread shots. Occasionally teleports and reappears elsewhere.

Name: Angelic Baby (small)
Description: Slowly floats towards Isaac and fires a blood shot at him. Occasionally teleports and reappears elsewhere. Can only be spawned by Holy Mulligans .

Name: Army Fly
Description: Chases Isaac, moving along the cardinal directions. Forms a line with other Army Flies in the room. Deals contact damage.

Name: Attack Fly
Description: Red fly that follows Isaac and deals contact damage.

Name: Baby
Description: Slowly floats towards Isaac and fires a blood shot at him. Occasionally teleports and reappears elsewhere.

Name: Baby Begotten
Description: Floats toward Isaac, avoiding his shots. After getting close, fires a short Brimstone laser in the closest cardinal direction and propels itself away from him.

Name: Baby Long Legs
Description: Runs away from Isaac and frequently spawns Spiders.

Name: Ball and Chain
Description: Spike balls that rotate at the end of a chain attached to an obstacle. If the obstacle is destroyed, the ball will fly free around the room for a while.

Name: Begotten
Description: Starts attached to the wall or an obstacle. After a while, it detaches, firing 6 blood shots in all directions, turning the room dark, becoming invisible and chasing Isaac. Briefly becomes visible upon getting hit.

Name: Big Bony
Description: Walks slowly toward Isaac, and will occasionally fire a bone that bounces around the room for a few moments. The bone can be broken if shot enough.

Name: Big Corn
Description: Quickly dashes in random directions, dealing contact damage. Shoots one piece of corn upon death.

Name: Big Spider
Description: Erratically moves around the room. If Isaac gets close to it, it chases him, trying to deal contact damage. Spawns two Spiders upon death.

Name: Bishop
Description: Shields all enemies in the room, preventing them from taking damage. Fires shots in the cardinal directions when it takes damage.

Name: Black Bony
Description: Wanders around the room and throws three bones in a row at Isaac when he is in sight. Explodes upon death.

Name: Black Globin
Description: Chases Isaac, dealing a full heart of contact damage and launching Spiders towards Isaac whenever it takes damage. Spawns a Spider, a Black Globin's Head , and a Black Globin's Body upon death.

Name: Black Globin's Body
Description: Walks aimlessly around the room, occasionally spawning spiders.

Name: Black Globin's Head
Description: Slides towards Isaac, leaving a trail of damaging Red Creep .

Name: Black Goat
Description: Wanders around the room. Occasionally moves toward Isaac, either firing blood shots at him or charging if he lines upon either side of it. Can also fire thin Brimstone lasers in the cardinal directions, along with all other Black Goats in the room.

Name: Black Knight
Description: Moves erratically around the room, charges toward Isaac when in line of sight. Unleashes waves of fire in all cardinal directions upon charging into an obstacle. Shots that hit it from the front are deflected back at Isaac.

Name: Black Maw
Description: When Isaac lines up with it horizontally, it charges in his direction and then doubles back, charging back to its original position. When Isaac is not horizontal to it, it spawns Leeches. Explodes when it dies.

Name: Blaster
Description: Slowly wanders around and occasionally shoots Fly Bombs at Isaac.

Name: Blind Creep
Description: Randomly crawls along walls and shoots three spread blood shots.

Name: Blister
Description: Slowly hops towards Isaac, occasionally spawning a Dark Ball. Spawns a Sack upon death.

Name: Bloat Eye
Description: Invulnerable enemy that floats diagonally over obstacles and bounces off of walls, blocking tears and dealing contact damage. Spawned by The Bloat as apart of his fight.

Name: Bloaty
Description: Lumbers around, occasionally spitting green shots and a line of damaging green creep in a random direction.

Name: Blood Cultist
Description: Wanders around the room and fires a line of blood shots and creep if Isaac is on either side of it. Can summons bone traps that temporarily ensnare Isaac if he walks into them.

Name: Blood Puppy
Description: Quickly moves around the room, attacking and charging at other monsters and Isaac when they get in its line of sight.

Name: Bloodfly
Description: Spawned only after a Pustule bursts. Flies in erratic, angled movements toward Isaac. Fires four blood shots in the cardinal directions upon death.

Name: Bloodshot Eye
Description: Slowly turns towards Isaac and fires a Brimstone beam at Isaac if he stands still or is too slow.

Name: Blubber
Description: Walks around aimlessly and randomly spews a cluster of blood shots in all directions. Has a chance to turn into a Half Sack when killed.

Name: Blue Boil
Description: Stationary enemy that decreases in size when hit, but regenerates to its full size until fully destroyed. Fires 1-3 blood shots towards Isaac when fully swollen.

Name: Blue Conjoined Fatty
Description: Slowly walks towards Isaac and occasionally farts out a homing Ipecac shot at Isaac.

Name: Blue Gaper
Description: Walks towards Isaac, dealing contact damage.

Name: Blurb
Description: Walks slowly towards Isaac, dealing contact damage. After taking some damage or getting close to Isaac, it fires a chaotic burst of tears at him and chases him more quickly. Can turn into a Pacer or Gusher upon death.

Name: Boil
Description: Stationary enemy that decreases in size when hit, but regenerates to its full size until fully destroyed. Fires multiple short-ranged blood projectiles in random directions when fully swollen.

Name: Bomb Grimace
Description: Stationary and invulnerable monster that keeps a single Throwable Bomb spawned.

Name: Bombgagger
Description: Spits up a Giga Bomb and runs away from it.

Name: Bone Fly
Description: Flies across the room in straight diagonal lines, dealing contact damage. Fires bones at Isaac if he lines up with it in the cardinal directions. Fires a radial burst of 3 bones upon death.

Name: Bone Knight
Description: Moves erratically around the room, charges toward Isaac when in line of sight, and leaves behind a short-lasting trail of damaging Red Creep. Can only be damaged from behind.

Name: Bony
Description: Wanders around the room and throws a bone at Isaac when he is in sight.

Name: Boom Fly
Description: Flies across the room in straight diagonal lines, dealing contact damage. Explodes upon death.

Name: Bouncer
Description: Wanders around the room, avoiding Isaac. If Isaac stays close to one for long enough, it inflates and starts chasing him, gaining a chance to deflect shots and causing it to explode into lingering blood shots on death.

Name: Brain
Description: Slowly crawls around the room, leaving a trail of Red Creep .

Name: Brainless Knight
Description: Alternates between running around the room along the cardinal directions and aimlessly walking in circles. Charges at Isaac when in line of sight. Dies when its corresponding Pon dies.

Name: Brimstone Death's Head
Description: Invulnerable enemy that moves diagonally around the room, pausing to fire a Brimstone laser when Isaac lines up with it in the cardinal directions. Dies when the room is cleared.

Name: Brimstone Head
Description: Stationary and invulnerable monster that fires Brimstone beams in a specific direction.

Name: Broken Gaping Maw
Description: Stationary and invulnerable monster that sucks Isaac towards it, along with Isaac's tears and enemy projectiles. Alternates between active and inactive every couple of seconds. Has a stronger attraction power than a regular Gaping Maw.

Name: Brownie Corn
Description: Quickly dashes in random directions, dealing contact damage.

Name: Bubbles
Description: Slowly walks towards Isaac, firing back shots upon taking damage. Occasionally farts, which pushes Isaac and adjacent enemies away and creates a chaotic burst of shots. Creates a geyser of water shots upon death.

Name: Bulb
Description: Flies in erratic, angled movements toward Isaac if his active item has charges; on contact, they drain up to 2 charges, but never deal contact damage. If he has no active item, or no charges, they wander around the room aimlessly.

Name: Butt Slicker
Description: Moves erratically around the room unless attached to another Butt Slicker. Grouped Butt Slickers drag themselves towards Isaac, and when an individual is killed they leave black creep, and shoot out black projectiles. The amount of projectiles released and the size of the pool of Black Creep  is determined by the amount of Butt Slickers attached.

Name: Buttlicker
Description: Can start attached to other Buttlickers and erratically moves around the room, similar to Larry Jr. .

Name: Camillo Jr.
Description: Moves around the room diagonally, occasionally firing Technology lasers towards Isaac. Fires more often upon getting damaged.

Name: Candler
Description: Flies around the room and propels itself by spawning flames.

Name: Carrion Princess
Description: Slowly moves around the room, charging at Isaac when he lines up diagonally with it. Can only be damaged by hitting its tail.

Name: Charger
Description: Slowly moves around the room, charging at Isaac when he gets in its line of sight.

Name: Chubber
Description: Randomly wanders around the room. Pauses to fire a Charger that deals one heart of damage when Isaac gets in its line of sight. The Charger is invulnerable, blocks Isaac's tears, has limited range, and flies back to the Chubber.

Name: Clickety Clack
Description: Walks towards Isaac and turn into a pile of bones when killed. Regenerates a few seconds after killed. Will only despawn if all Clickety Clacks in the room are killed.

Name: Cloggy
Description: Randomly wanders around the room, firing four curved brown shots in the cardinal directions. These shots alternate between rotating clockwise and counterclockwise with each shot.

Name: Clot
Description: Randomly wanders around the room, firing 4 tar shots in the ordinal directions.

Name: Clotty
Description: Randomly wanders around the room, firing 4 blood shots in the cardinal directions.

Name: Coal Boy
Description: Walks toward Isaac and spits hot coals at him, some of which may be Coal Spiders .

Name: Coal Spider
Description: Quickly crawls around the room. If it sees Isaac, it crawls at him, trying to deal contact damage. Turns into a hot coal upon death that blocks shots and deals contact damage, but can be destroyed.

Name: Cod Worm
Description: Stationary enemy that hides in a shell and spews a burst of blood shots if shot at. Only vulnerable when it pops its head out.

Name: Cohort
Description: Acts similarly to Monstro , hopping towards Isaac and can either spit a large projectile towards Isaac that bursts into 8 smaller projectiles or cough up a burst of arcing projectiles and a pile of Globin goo. Spawns 4 piles of Globin goo upon death.

Name: Conjoined Fatty
Description: Slowly walks towards Isaac. Occasionally pauses to fart out a line of damaging Green Creep towards Isaac. Chance to turn into a regular Fatty upon death.

Name: Conjoined Spitty
Description: Slowly moves around the room, occasionally firing a blood shot from both ends of its body.

Name: Constant Stone Shooter
Description: Stationary and invulnerable monster that continuously fires shots in a single direction.

Name: Corn
Description: Quickly dashes in random directions, dealing contact damage.

Name: Corn Mine
Description: Goes off when destroyed or after some time, then releases a cloud of poisonous gas and fires corny shots in eight directions.

Name: Crackle
Description: Walks toward Isaac, dealing contact damage and spitting fireballs that create lines of fire in the cardinal directions on impact.

Name: Crazy Long Legs
Description: Chases Isaac, dealing touch damage. Occasionally stops to spit 8 blood shots in all directions.

Name: Crispy
Description: Slowly walks towards Isaac, but increases in speed as they take damage. Constantly passively takes damage.

Name: Cross Stone Shooter
Description: Stationary and invulnerable monster that continuously fires shots in four directions, alternating between cardinal and ordinal.

Name: Cross Stoney
Description: Chases Isaac and shoots 4 tears vertically and diagonally like a Cross Stone Shooter . Dies when the room is cleared. Only appears in Aprils Fool (challenge #32) as replacements to regular Stoneys.

Name: Cultist
Description: Creates an indestructible, homing Purple Ball at the start of the room and follows it around, occasionally leaving it to revive enemies that have died in the current room.

Name: Cursed Death's Head
Description: Invulnerable enemy that moves diagonally around the room, dealing contact damage.  If Isaac enters its purple aura, he will be inflicted with fear and be temporarily unable to shoot. Dies when the room is cleared.

Name: Cursed Globin
Description: Chases Isaac, dealing a full heart of contact damage. Upon taking enough damage, it collapses into 1-2 piles of goo, each of which can be killed and regenerate after a short period of time if not killed quickly. These goo piles have less health the more times the Cursed Globin splits.

Name: Cyclopia
Description: Walks towards Isaac, dealing contact damage and leaving behind a short-lasting trail of damaging Red Creep . Occasionally shoots a blood shot towards Isaac.

Name: Cyst
Description: Attaches itself to a wall or obstacle and rolls around it, regularly firing blood shots at Isaac.

Name: Dank Charger
Description: Slowly moves around the room, launching itself at Isaac if he gets in its line of sight. Bounces off of walls and leaves a trail of slowing Black Creep while charging.

Name: Dank Death's Head
Description: Moves diagonally around the room, dealing contact damage. Needs to be killed to complete the room.

Name: Dank Globin
Description: Chases Isaac, dealing a full heart of contact damage. Upon taking enough damage, it collapses into a pile of goo, spawns a Spider , and leaves a puddle of slowing Black Creep . Will regenerate after a short time if not killed quickly. Leaves another puddle of Black Creep upon death.

Name: Dank Squirt
Description: Dashes towards Isaac and deals contact damage, creating slowing black creep . Spawns 2 Clots upon death.

Name: Danny
Description: Walks toward Isaac and spits chaotic bursts of rocks at him, some of which may be Rock Spiders .

Name: Dark Ball
Description: Floats towards Isaac, doing contact damage.

Name: Dart Fly
Description: Flies towards Isaac and attempts to predict his movements. Deals contact damage.

Name: Dead Isaac
Description: Summoned by Mother at the bottom of the arena, they walk upward (ignoring Isaac completely), and deal contact damage. Releases a burst of blood shots upon being killed by Mother, while she launches their corpses towards Isaac.

Name: Dead Meat
Description: Slowly moves around the room, occasionally hopping and firing 8 large blood shots in all directions that bounce off the walls. Splits into 2 Cysts upon death.

Name: Death Scythe
Description: Stays stationary for a few seconds, then homes in on Isaac.

Name: Death's Head
Description: Invulnerable enemy that moves diagonally around the room, dealing contact damage. Dies when the room is cleared.

Name: Deep Gaper
Description: Emerges from the floor once all previous enemies have been killed, then proceeds to chase Isaac. Deals contact damage.

Name: Dinga
Description: Slowly moves around the room, occasionally hopping to spawn Dips or fire 8 Brown shots in all directions. Splits 2 Squirts upon death.

Name: Dip
Description: Slowly dashes in random directions, dealing contact damage.

Name: Dople
Description: Mirrors Isaac's movements and fires blood shots at the same time as Isaac. Can be damaged by spikes.

Name: Double Vis
Description: Randomly wanders around the room. Pauses to charge and fire a Brimstone laser which fires from both sides when Isaac gets in its line of sight.

Name: Dragon Fly
Description: Flies across the room in straight diagonal lines, dealing contact damage. Upon death, creates four lines of fire in the cardinal directions; the fire nearly spans the length of an entire normal-sized room.

Name: Dragon Fly X
Description: Flies across the room in straight diagonal lines, dealing contact damage. Upon death, creates four lines of fire in the ordinal directions; the fire nearly spans the length of an entire normal-sized room.

Name: Drip
Description: Quickly rolls around in diagonal directions, dealing contact damage.

Name: Drowned Boom Fly
Description: Flies across the room in straight diagonal lines, dealing contact damage. Upon death, explodes and fires four blood shots in the cardinal directions. Also has a chance to spawn a Drowned Charger upon death.

Name: Drowned Charger
Description: Slowly moves around the room, charging at Isaac when he gets in its line of sight. Explodes into four blood shots in the ordinal directions upon death.

Name: Drowned Hive
Description: Wanders around the room, avoiding Isaac and spawning Drowned Chargers if he gets close. Spawns 0-2 Drowned Chargers upon death.

Name: Dukie
Description: Flies around the room diagonally, occasionally spitting out 1-2 Dart Flies .

Name: Dummy
Description: Only encounterable through Debug Console , it is immobile, harmless, and used to track Isaac's damage.

Name: Dump
Description: Slides toward Isaac, leaving a trail of slippery brown creep . After taking enough damage, its head slides off and quickly bounces around the room and its body spews out brown shots until it empties.

Name: Dump Head
Description: Quickly slides toward Isaac, leaving a trail of slippery brown creep . Can spawn on its own or be created by a Dump after it takes enough damage.

Name: Dust
Description: Follows Isaac, and is only visible when close to Isaac. Will begin to speed up when they are visible. Teleports away after taking enough damage.

Name: Dusty Death's Head
Description: Invulnerable enemy that moves across the room in a waving motion in large quantities. Dies when the room is cleared.

Name: Eggy
Description: Hops aimlessly around the room, spawning slowing white creep wherever it hops. Spawns a group of Swarm Spiders upon death.

Name: Elleech
Description: Slowly moves around the room. After Isaac gets in its line of sight, continuously charges at him in the closest cardinal direction.

Name: Embryo
Description: Aimlessly hops around the room, dealing contact damage.

Name: Eternal Fly
Description: Invulnerable fly that circles Corny Poop and various monsters. Deals contact damage. Turns into a vulnerable Attack Fly after the object or monster it circles is destroyed.

Name: Eternal Fly Bomb
Description: Orbits Boom Flies spawned by The Horny Boys . Once its Boom Fly has been killed, turns into a tiny Bomb .

Name: Evil Twin
Description: Mirrors Isaac's movements and fires three spread blood shots at the same time as Isaac. Can fly over obstacles.

Name: Evis
Description: Randomly wanders around the room. Launches a string of guts when Isaac gets close to it, which it uses to pull Isaac toward itself.

Name: Exorcist
Description: Summons The Heretic before transforming into Fanatics .

Name: Eye
Description: Slowly turns towards Isaac and fires a Technology laser at Isaac if he stands still or is too slow.

Name: Faceless
Description: Wanders around the room, rarely firing a radial burst of six shots. Chases Isaac and fires shots more frequently after taking damage.

Name: Fanatic
Description: Transformed into from Exorcists . Chases Isaac and occasionally fires two purple, rotating shots.

Name: Fat Bat
Description: Slowly flies towards Isaac. Tries to align itself diagonally to Isaac and shoots at him when in that alignment.

Name: Fat Sack
Description: Slowly walks towards Isaac. Occasionally leaps off-screen and attempts to land on Isaac, leaving a puddle of Red Creep and shooting 6 blood shots in all directions where it lands. Has a chance to turn into a Blubber upon death.

Name: Fatty
Description: Slowly walks towards Isaac. Occasionally farts, which pushes Isaac and adjacent enemies away.

Name: Festering Guts
Description: Spawned by Gutted Fatties , Festering Guts randomly slide around the room and occasionally spawn a Charger .

Name: Fetal Demon
Description: Usually encountered tethered to Vis Fatties . When tethered it makes short lunges towards Isaac if he gets close. If the Vis Fatty is killed or when encountered alone, it will chase Isaac, similarly to Gemini 's Suture.

Name: Fire Worm
Description: Pops out of the ground in random locations in the lava and fires one flame at Isaac.

Name: Fissure
Description: Jumps out of pits and bounces around the room. Spawns endlessly from pits until room clear. Do not need to be killed to clear room.

Name: Fistuloid
Description: Flies towards Isaac in an erratic waving motion, periodically firing a blood shot towards Isaac that also knocks itself back. Upon death, fires a worm that flies off screen.

Name: Flagellant
Description: Runs around the room. When Isaac gets in its line of sight, continuously chases him and lashes its whip, occasionally deflecting Isaac’s shots.

Name: Flaming Fatty
Description: Slowly walks towards Isaac. Occasionally farts, which pushes Isaac and adjacent enemies away and spawns a damaging flame. Has a chance to leave behind a damaging flame upon death.

Name: Flaming Gaper
Description: Walks towards Isaac, dealing contact damage. Usually turns into a Pacer or Gusher upon death.

Name: Flaming Hopper
Description: Quickly hops around the room, doing contact damage. Covers a larger distance than the regular Hopper.

Name: Flesh Death's Head
Description: Moves diagonally around the room, dealing contact damage. Releases 6 blood shots in all directions upon death. Can be killed, but also dies when the room is cleared.

Name: Flesh Maiden
Description: Vaguely flies towards Isaac in curved swooping motions.

Name: Flesh Mobile Host
Description: Acts like the Red Host, but follows Isaac and deals contact damage.

Name: Floast
Description: Floats diagonally around the room and is normally invulnerable. When Isaac gets close, reveals a fleshy stem that can be damaged and fires 3 blood shots in an angle at him before hiding its stem again.

Name: Floating Knight
Description: Behaves like the Knight but slower, and can fly over all obstacles.

Name: Fly
Description: Hovers in place. Does not deal contact damage and is harmless, but can turn into Pooters if they stay around Poop .

Name: Fly Bomb
Description: Flies toward Isaac, circling around him as it does. Turn into a tiny Bomb upon death.

Name: Fly Trap
Description: Floats towards Isaac, with 3 Attack Flies circling around it. Coughs up additional Attack Flies and releases gas to launch the Attack Flies outwards.

Name: Fred
Description: Hops out of the ground and burrows elsewhere, firing 4 blood shots in the cardinal directions. Occasionally fires red Ipecac shots at Isaac.

Name: Frowning Gaper
Description: Walks towards Isaac, dealing contact damage. They start out with their eyes closed, but when they gain line of sight with Isaac, their eyes open and they permanently move faster. Usually turns into a Pacer or with a small chance a Gusher upon death.

Name: Full Fly
Description: Flies toward Isaac erratically, dealing contact damage. Releases 6 bullets in all directions upon death.

Name: Gaper
Description: Walks towards Isaac, dealing contact damage. Usually turns into a Pacer or a Gusher upon death.

Name: Gaping Maw
Description: Stationary and invulnerable monster that sucks Isaac towards it, along with Isaac's tears and enemy projectiles.

Name: Gas Dwarf
Description: Chases Isaac, periodically coughing up gas clouds. On death, fires an explosive shot that can detonate gas clouds it hits.

Name: Gasbag
Description: Occasionally summons Army Flies to chase Isaac. Is surrounded by a ring of toxic gas that hurts Isaac if he stands in it for too long.

Name: Gazing Globin
Description: Quickly chases Isaac, dealing a full heart of contact damage. Upon taking enough damage, it collapses into a pile of goo, which will slide away from Isaac and can be killed. Will regenerate after a short period of time if not killed quickly.

Name: Globin
Description: Chases Isaac, dealing a full heart of contact damage. Upon taking enough damage, it collapses into a pile of goo, which can be killed. Will regenerate after a short period of time if not killed quickly.

Name: Goat
Description: Wanders around the room. Occasionally moves toward Isaac, either firing blood shots at him or charging if he lines up on either side of it.

Name: Greed Gaper
Description: Walks towards Isaac, dealing contact damage.

Name: Grilled Clotty
Description: Quickly and randomly wanders around the room, firing four flame shots in the cardinal directions at a slight angle.

Name: Grilled Gyro
Description: Rolls around like a wheel. Charges at Isaac when he is in line of sight, bouncing off of walls and obstacles and creating fires behind itself as it does.

Name: Grub
Description: Erratically moves around the room like Larry Jr. and charges at Isaac when he gets within its line of sight. Spawns Maggots , Chargers , or Spitties upon death, one for each of its segments.

Name: Grudge
Description: Quickly slides towards Isaac when he gets in its line of sight. Cannot be destroyed.

Name: Gurgle
Description: Walks towards Isaac, dealing contact damage and periodically firing Ipecac shots at him; they are immune to this explosion, but other enemies are not. Can turn into a Splasher upon death.

Name: Gurgling
Description: Charges towards Isaac when he lines up with them, leaving a trail of Red Creep and shooting 6 blood shots.

Name: Gush
Description: Stationary, harmless enemy that continually creates slowing black creep .

Name: Gusher
Description: Walks aimlessly around the room, occasionally firing a short-ranged blood shot.

Name: Gut
Description: Stationary enemy that decreases in size when hit, but regenerates to its full size until fully destroyed. Fires Ipecac shots in random directions when fully swollen.

Name: Guts
Description: Attaches itself to a wall or obstacle and rolls around it.

Name: Gutted Fatty
Description: Slowly lumbers around the room, occasionally spawning Festering Guts . Its eyes dislocate as it takes damage, which are invincible and follow the Gutted Fatty but chase Isaac if he gets close to them. Creates a geyser of blood projectiles upon death.

Name: Gutted Fatty Eye
Description: Invulnerable enemy spawned by Gutted Fatties. Hovers around their correlating Gutted Fatty unless Isaac draws near, after which it will chase Isaac, blocking tears and dealing contact damage.

Name: Gyro
Description: Rolls around like a wheel. Charges at Isaac when he is in line of sight, bouncing off of walls and obstacles as it does.

Name: Half Sack
Description: Wanders around aimlessly and leaves a trail of Red Creep.

Name: Hanger
Description: Floats around the room, firing 3 spread blood shots at Isaac. Upon damaging Isaac, Isaac drops 2 coins on the ground but loses 3. Spawns with an Eternal Fly circling around it.

Name: Hard Host
Description: Stationary enemy that is normally invulnerable. Raises its head up when Isaac gets close, revealing a fleshy stem that can be damaged. Shortly after raising its head, it slams its head down and fires a rock wave towards Isaac.

Name: Hardy
Description: Dashes toward Isaac and deals contact damage creating rock projectiles when it hits a wall/obstacle. It spawns more rock projectiles the more times it crashes into obstacles, dying after doing so a third time.

Name: Henry
Description: Flushes itself away shortly after Isaac enters the room.

Name: Hive
Description: Wanders around the room, avoiding Isaac and spawning Attack Flies if he gets close. Spawns a large number of flies on death, which can be Flies , Attack Flies , and/or Pooters .

Name: Holy Bony
Description: Wanders around the room, throwing a bone at Isaac when he is in sight. The thrown bone leaves behind a blue flame that deals contact damage, blocks Isaac’s shots, and despawns after some time.

Name: Holy Eye
Description: Rapidly summons several beams of light around Isaac every few seconds.

Name: Holy Leech
Description: Quickly charges towards Isaac when he gets in its line of sight. Explodes upon death. Spawns with an Eternal Fly circling it, which instantly dies when the Holy Leech explodes.

Name: Holy Mulligan
Description: Wanders around the room, avoiding Isaac and spawning Angelic Baby (small) if he gets close. Spawns 1-2 Embryos upon death.

Name: Homunculus
Description: Starts attached to the wall or an obstacle. After a while, it detaches, shooting 6 blood shots in all directions, leaving a puddle of Red Creep and chasing Isaac. If it dies while still attached, it will still leave a puddle of Red Creep.

Name: Hopper
Description: Slowly hops around the room, doing contact damage. Can turn into a Flaming Hopper by jumping into Fire Places or other fires.

Name: Horf
Description: Stationary enemy that fires a medium-ranged blood shot at Isaac when he gets in range of them.

Name: Host
Description: Stationary enemy that is normally invulnerable. Raises its head up when Isaac gets close, revealing a fleshy stem that can be damaged. Upon raising its head, it will fire 3 blood shots in a spread and lower its head again.

Name: Hush Fly
Description: Gathers with other Hush Flies to form certain patterns. If spawned by Hush , can chase Isaac or orbit Hush. Deals contact damage.

Name: I.Blob
Description: Randomly wanders around the room, firing 8 shots in all directions.

Name: Imp
Description: Slowly drifts towards Isaac, frequently firing 5 blood shots in quick succession towards him. Tries to avoid Isaac's shots and occasionally teleports and reappears elsewhere.

Name: Ink
Description: Flies slowly towards Isaac. Fires four shots in the ordinal directions and leaves a puddle of slowing Black Creep upon death.

Name: Kamikaze Leech
Description: Quickly charges towards Isaac when he gets in its line of sight. Explodes upon death.

Name: Keeper
Description: Hops around the room, firing 2 blood shots in a V formation at Isaac. Upon damaging Isaac, Isaac drops 2 coins on the ground but loses 3.

Name: Kineti
Description: Uses telekinesis to pick up and throw rocks and obstacles at Isaac.

Name: Knight
Description: Moves erratically around the room and charges towards Isaac when in line of sight. Can only be damaged from behind.

Name: Leaper
Description: Hops around the room, doing contact damage. Occasionally jumps high into the air, dropping down onto Isaac's position while firing 4 blood shots in the cardinal directions.

Name: Leech
Description: Quickly charges towards Isaac when he gets in its line of sight.

Name: Leper
Description: Alternating between walking towards and running away from Isaac. Releases a Leper Flesh each time it takes enough damage. At low health, constantly chases Isaac and leaves behind damaging red creep . Spawns a Leper Flesh and Gusher upon death.

Name: Leper Flesh
Description: Floats slowly toward Isaac and fires a predictive projectile at him upon death.

Name: Level 2 Charger
Description: Slowly moves around the room, charging at Isaac when he gets in its line of sight. Can slowly change its trajectory while charging.

Name: Level 2 Fly
Description: Flies toward Isaac erratically, dealing contact damage.

Name: Level 2 Gaper
Description: Walks towards Isaac, dealing a full Heart of contact damage. Splits into a Level 2 Horf and Level 2 Gusher upon death.

Name: Level 2 Gusher
Description: Runs aimlessly around the room, spitting up Small Maggots .

Name: Level 2 Horf
Description: Slowly floats toward Isaac, spitting Small Maggots at him.

Name: Level 2 Spider
Description: Crawls around the room erratically, following Isaac and dealing contact damage. Can jump small distances.

Name: Level 2 Willo
Description: Orbits enemies and shoots tears at Isaac. If the enemy it is orbiting dies, it will orbit another enemy. However, if all enemies are dead, it will chase Isaac, while still occasionally shooting at Isaac.

Name: Lil Portal
Description: Spawns fly and spider enemies until it is destroyed.

Name: Lil' Haunt
Description: Floats toward Isaac and occasionally fires a blood shot at him, predicting his movements.

Name: Loose Knight
Description: Moves erratically around the room, charges toward Isaac when in line of sight. When its health is depleted, it turns into a Brainless Knight and a Pon .

Name: Lump
Description: Fires 3 spread blood shots at Isaac when he gets in its line of sight. Will burrow underground and reappear elsewhere after firing.

Name: Maggot
Description: Aimlessly moves around the room, dealing contact damage.

Name: Mama Fly
Description: Flies more-or-less away from Isaac, occasionally plopping on the ground to plant a Pustule . Upon death, they spawn a group of Small Maggots .

Name: Mama Guts
Description: Slowly moves around the room, occasionally hopping and firing 8 large blood shots in all directions. Splits into 2 Guts upon death.

Name: Mask + Heart
Description: The Mask is invulnerable and moves around erratically, charging at Isaac when he lines up with it. The Heart avoids Isaac and fires 4 blood shots in the cardinal directions when Isaac gets near. Killing the Heart will automatically kill the Mask.

Name: Mask II + 1/2 Heart
Description: The Mask is invulnerable and moves around erratically, charging at Isaac when he lines up with it. The Heart avoids Isaac and fires 4 blood shots in the ordinal directions when Isaac gets near. Killing the Heart will automatically kill the Mask. If there are more than one 1/2 Heart in the room, they will fire blood shots between each other.

Name: Maw
Description: Slowly floats towards Isaac, firing a blood shot at him when he is in their range.

Name: Maze Roamer
Description: Wanders around the room and shoots an eyeball at Isaac when he is in sight. Has a clone of itself on the other side of the room that mimics its movement and shots. If one dies, the other starts actively pursuing Isaac.

Name: Meatball
Description: Slides around the room. If Isaac is in sight, it will stop to spew a fountain of short-range blood shots in all directions or to spit a line of damaging Red Creep towards Isaac. Spawns a Host upon death.

Name: Mega Clotty
Description: Slowly moves around the room, occasionally hopping and either firing 6 blood shots in all directions, leaving a puddle of Red Creep, or spawning a Clotty or a collapsed Globin . Splits into two Clotties upon death.

Name: MemBrain
Description: Slowly moves around the room, occasionally hopping and firing 8 large blood shots in all directions. Splits into 2 Brains upon death.

Name: Migraine
Description: Crawls around the room erratically, following Isaac and dealing contact damage. Can jump small distances. Releases multiple Troll Bombs upon death.

Name: Ministro
Description: Hops around randomly and hop towards Isaac when he gets close, occasionally spitting out a cluster of disorganized shots.

Name: Mobile Host
Description: Acts like the Host, but follows Isaac and deals contact damage.

Name: Mockulus
Description: Invulnerable enemy that rapidly floats diagonally over obstacles and bounces off of walls, blocking tears and dealing contact damage. They can only move while Isaac is shooting.

Name: Mole
Description: Burrows towards Isaac and jumps out the ground to fire 3 blood shots at him.

Name: Mom's Dead Hand
Description: Falls from the ceiling. Upon landing, it spawns several rock waves that travel outwards. Spawns several spiders upon death. Entering a room containing Mom's Dead Hand will warn Isaac with Mom's laugh.

Name: Mom's Hand
Description: Falls from the ceiling. If it lands on Isaac, it deals damage and teleports him back to the spawn room of the floor. Entering a room containing Mom's Hand will warn Isaac with Mom's laugh.

Name: Morningstar
Description: Floats toward Isaac to deal contact damage while Isaac is moving, gaining speed the longer Isaac continues moving. Stops moving when Isaac stops moving.

Name: Moter
Description: Follows Isaac, similar to Attack Flies . Deals contact damage. Splits into 2 Attack Flies upon death.

Name: Mr. Maw
Description: Walks towards Isaac and attacks by launching its head towards him. Turns into a Maw or Gusher upon death depending on the killed body segment. Occasionally separates at will.

Name: Mr. Mine
Description: Can only appear in pits. Attempts to launch itself at Isaac if he comes near. Occasionally burrows and pops up in another pit, and fires six shots in all directions upon death.

Name: Mr. Red Maw
Description: Walks towards Isaac and attacks by launching its head towards him. Turns into a Red Maw or Gusher upon death depending on the killed body segment. Occasionally separates at will.

Name: Mulliboom
Description: Chases Isaac and explodes upon death or upon touching Isaac. The explosion deals a half-heart of damage instead of the regular full heart.

Name: Mulligan
Description: Walks around the room, avoiding Isaac. Upon death, spawns several flies, which can be Flies , Attack Flies , and/or Pooters . Can self-detonate and launch four projectiles in the cardinal directions while still releasing flies.

Name: Mullighoul
Description: Wanders around the room, avoiding Isaac and spawning Willos if he gets close. Spawns 1-2 Willos upon death.

Name: Mulligoon
Description: Walks around the room, avoiding Isaac. Upon death, spawns a Troll Bomb and fires four shots in the ordinal directions. Can self-detonate, spawn a Troll bomb, and launch eight projectiles in all directions.

Name: Mushroom
Description: Stationary enemy that occasionally pops up and fires four shots in the cardinal or diagonal directions. Takes less damage while its head is down.

Name: My Shadow
Description: Charges at enemies when in its line of sight, dealing contact damage. Will always spawn friendly via My Shadow .

Name: Necro
Description: Stationary enemy that summons unlimited-ranged bones to attack Isaac.

Name: Needle
Description: Pops out of the ground and lunges towards Isaac, dealing contact damage.

Name: Nerve Ending
Description: Static enemy which acts as a meat shield.

Name: Nerve Ending 2
Description: Static enemy which whips at Isaac if he gets too close.

Name: Nest
Description: Wanders around the room, avoiding Isaac and spawning Spiders if he gets close. Spawns a Big Spider or Trite upon death.

Name: Night Crawler
Description: Pops out of the ground in random locations and fires four short-range shots that spiral outwards if Isaac is in sight.

Name: Nulls
Description: Walks towards Isaac, dealing contact damage. Upon getting near Isaac, it will open its eyes, though its speed doesn't change. Fades into and out of visibility.

Name: One Tooth
Description: Follows Isaac and periodically dashes towards him when it gets close. Deals contact damage.

Name: Oob
Description: When Isaac lines up with it horizontally, it charges across the room once. When Isaac is not horizontal to it, it spawns Brains.

Name: Pacer
Description: Walks aimlessly around the room.

Name: Pale Fatty
Description: Slowly walks towards Isaac. Occasionally farts and shoots 6 blood shots in all directions. Has a chance to turn into a Blubber upon death.

Name: Para-Bite
Description: Moves towards Isaac, dealing contact damage. Can burrow underground and reappear elsewhere.

Name: Pasty
Description: Pops out of the ground and lunges toward Isaac, dealing contact damage and firing four shots in the ordinal directions.

Name: Peep Eye
Description: Invulnerable enemy that floats diagonally over obstacles and bounces off of walls, blocking tears and dealing contact damage. Spawned by Peep as apart of his fight.

Name: Peeping Fatty
Description: Has two indestructible Peeping Fatty Eyes that are out of their sockets but attached by muscles. Wanders around the room randomly, or toward Isaac if its eyes see him. Occasionally farts and fires a radial burst of 6 blood shots.

Name: Peeping Fatty Eye
Description: Invulnerable enemy attached to a Peeping Fatty. Follows Isaac when in line of sight, blocking tears and dealing contact damage.

Name: Pitfall
Description: Invulnerable and stationary enemy which Isaac falls into when walked over, taking damage and popping back out after a short delay.

Name: Planetoid
Description: Moves around the room diagonally, occasionally firing blood shots that orbit itself. Fires more shots and has a chance to send its ring of shots outward upon taking damage.

Name: Poison Mind
Description: Slowly crawls/ floats around the room diagonally, leaving a trail of damaging green creep . Explodes upon death.

Name: Poky
Description: Slides around the room aimlessly, damaging Isaac by contact. Disappears when the room is cleared.

Name: Polty
Description: Picks up and throws rocks and props at Isaac.

Name: Pon
Description: Hops around the room, leaving damaging red creep wherever it lands. Upon death, its associated Brainless Knight dies with it.

Name: Poofer
Description: Slowly floats toward Isaac, swells up and fire 6 blood shots in all directions upon taking damage. Explodes upon death, healing nearby enemies and leaving a big puddle of red creep.

Name: Poot Mine
Description: Creates a gas cloud and propels itself away from Isaac when it gets hit non-consecutively. Explodes on death, detonating all the gas clouds it created.

Name: Pooter
Description: Slowly drifts toward Isaac, occasionally firing a single blood shot at him. Does not deal contact damage.

Name: Portal
Description: Spawns various enemies from the current floor until it either vanishes or is killed.

Name: Prey
Description: Wanders around the room, avoiding Isaac and spawning Small Leeches if he gets close. Spawns 3 Small Leeches upon death.

Name: Psy Tumor
Description: Moves around the room diagonally, occasionally firing 6 homing shots in all directions. Fires more often upon getting damaged.

Name: Psychic Horf
Description: Stationary enemy that fires a homing shot at Isaac when he gets in range of them.

Name: Psychic Maw
Description: Slowly floats towards Isaac, firing homing shots at him when he is in their range. Spawns with an Eternal Fly orbiting around it.

Name: Purple Ball
Description: Floats towards Isaac, doing contact damage.

Name: Pustule
Description: Slowly increases in size over time, spawning Small Maggots and damaging red creep depending on its size upon death. If it grows to full size, it transforms into a Bloodfly .

Name: Quad Revenant
Description: Wanders around the room slowly, stopping to fire lines of flames in the cardinal or ordinal directions, rotating in an attempt to hit Isaac.

Name: Quake Grimace
Description: Stationary and invulnerable monster that jumps and fires a line of rocks in one direction upon landing.

Name: Quakey
Description: Walks slowly toward Isaac, occasionally attempting to jump on Isaac, shooting out 8 rock shots when it hits the ground and causing rocks to fall from the ceiling.

Name: Rag Man's Ragling
Description: Quickly leaps towards Isaac and deals contact damage. Randomly shoots two purple shots that orbit around it.

Name: Rage Creep
Description: Slowly crawls along walls to try to line up with Isaac and shoots a Brimstone laser.

Name: Ragling
Description: Quickly leaps towards Isaac and deals contact damage. Randomly shoots two purple shots that orbit around it.

Name: Red Boom Fly
Description: Flies across the room in straight diagonal lines, dealing contact damage. Creates a ring of 6 blood shots upon death.

Name: Red Ghost
Description: Disappears, then reappears near Isaac and fires a brimstone laser.

Name: Red Host
Description: Stationary enemy that can be damaged even when its head is lowered. Fire 5 spread blood shots when it raises its head.

Name: Red Maw
Description: Floats quickly towards Isaac and releases 4 blood shots in the cardinal directions upon death.

Name: Redskull
Description: Moves diagonally around the room, creating a ring of fire around itself if Isaac gets close to it. Can be killed, but also dies when the room is cleared.

Name: Revenant
Description: Slowly wanders around the room, stopping to fire a large line of fire at the player.

Name: Ring Fly
Description: Gathers with any other Ring Flies in the room. These flies orbit around themselves while following Isaac. Deals contact damage.

Name: Rock Spider
Description: Slowly crawls around the room. If it sees Isaac, it crawls at him, trying to deal contact damage. Turns into a Spider upon death. Turns into a Coal Spider if it touches fire.

Name: Rotten Gaper
Description: Walks toward Isaac, dealing contact damage. Its behavior varies slightly depending on its facial expression.

Name: Rotty
Description: Slowly walks towards Isaac, leaving short-lasting Red Creep behind itself. Spawns a Bony or two Attack Flies upon death.

Name: Round Worm
Description: Pops out of the ground in random locations and spits a blood shot at Isaac if he is in sight.

Name: Roundy
Description: Pops out of the ground in random locations, creating a small rock wave. Fires an explosive Ipecac shot at Isaac if he is in sight.

Name: Sack
Description: Stationary enemy that decreases in size when hit, but regenerates to its full size until fully destroyed. Occasionally spawns Spiders when fully swollen.

Name: Scarred Double Vis
Description: Randomly wanders around the room. Pauses to charge and fire a Brimstone laser which fires from all four cardinal sides when Isaac gets in its line of sight.

Name: Scarred Guts
Description: Attaches itself to a wall or obstacle and rolls around it, leaving a trail of damaging Red Creep.

Name: Scarred Para-Bite
Description: Moves towards Isaac, dealing contact damage and firing a short-range blood shot at him. Can burrow underground and reappear elsewhere.

Name: Selfless Knight
Description: Moves erratically around the room and charges towards Isaac very quickly when in line of sight. Can only be damaged from behind.

Name: Shady
Description: Walks slowly toward Isaac, occasionally firing a shot that creates shots perpendicular to itself while traveling and splits into a ring of shots upon hitting a wall or obstacle. Also occasionally jumps, creating lines of explosions in the cardinal directions. One of the few enemies that utilize Damage Scaling .

Name: Sick Boom Fly
Description: Flies across the room in straight diagonal lines, dealing contact damage and trailing poisonous gas. Upon death, explodes into a gas cloud and fires a ring of 6 green shots.

Name: Singe's Ball
Description: Spawned exclusively as apart Singe 's boss fight and used in his attacks. They can be pushed around and launched with explosions.

Name: Siren Helper
Description: Spawned in by The Siren and takes the form and control of all of her charmed familiars.

Name: Siren Minion
Description: Spawned in automatically charmed by The Siren . Orbits the boss and fires projectiles towards Isaac.

Name: Skinny
Description: Slowly walks towards Isaac, leaving short-lasting Red Creep behind itself.

Name: Slide
Description: Quickly slides towards Isaac when he gets in its line of sight, then moves slowly back to its original position. Cannot be destroyed.

Name: Slog
Description: Attaches itself to a wall or obstacle and rolls around it, charging at Isaac when he is in sight.

Name: Small Baby Long Legs
Description: Runs away from Isaac and occasionally spawns Sacks.

Name: Small Crazy Long Legs
Description: Chases Isaac, dealing touch damage. Occasionally stops to spit 4 blood shots in the diagonal directions.

Name: Small Leech
Description: Chases Isaac continuously, not stopping at walls. Able to swim over gaps.

Name: Small Maggot
Description: Slowly crawls toward Isaac, dealing contact damage.

Name: Snapper
Description: Runs around the room, sprinting at Isaac when he gets in its line of sight and throwing out its whip when he gets in range.

Name: Soul Sucker
Description: Flies slowly towards Isaac. Spawns a vortex that fires four Brimstone beams in the cardinal directions upon death.

Name: Soy Creep
Description: Slowly crawls along walls to try to line up with Isaac and shoots a stream of shots seemingly affected by Soy Milk .

Name: Spider
Description: Erratically moves around the room. If Isaac gets close to it, it chases him, trying to deal contact damage.

Name: Spikeball
Description: Spike balls that fly in a line either horizontally or vertically, bouncing off walls and obstacles.

Name: Spit
Description: Flies slowly towards Isaac, firing an Ipecac shot towards Isaac upon death.

Name: Spitty
Description: Slowly moves around the room, occasionally firing a single blood shot forward.

Name: Splasher
Description: Walks aimlessly around the room, firing Ipecac shots in random directions.

Name: Splurt
Description: Dashes towards Isaac twice and deals contact damage. Spawns 2 Drips upon death.

Name: Squirt
Description: Dashes towards Isaac and deals contact damage. Spawns 2 Dips upon death.

Name: Sticky Leaper
Description: Hops around the room, dealing contact damage. Occasionally jumps high into the air, dropping down onto Isaac's position while creating a chaotic burst of tar shots in all directions and a puddle of slowing black creep .

Name: Stone Eye
Description: Stationary and invulnerable monster that constantly rotates and fires a flickering Technology laser. Stops firing when the room is cleared.

Name: Stone Grimace
Description: Stationary and invulnerable monster that occasionally fires a blood shot at Isaac. Stops firing when room is cleared.

Name: Stoney
Description: Chases Isaac and blocks tears, but does not deal contact damage. Temporarily pauses in exhaustion after a certain amount of time. Invulnerable; dies when the room is cleared.

Name: Strider
Description: Erratically swims around the room. If it sees Isaac, it chases him, trying to deal contact damage.

Name: Sub Horf
Description: Stationary enemy that spins and fires shots while being moved around or knocked back.

Name: Sucker
Description: Flies slowly towards Isaac, exploding into 4 shots in the cardinal directions upon death.

Name: Suction Pitfall
Description: Invulnerable and stationary enemy which sucks Isaac towards itself. Isaac falls into it when walked over, taking damage and popping back out after a short delay.

Name: Super Pooter
Description: Slowly drifts toward Isaac, occasionally firing two blood shots in a V-formation at him. Does not deal contact damage.

Name: Swarm
Description: Follows Isaac in large, tightly-clustered groups and deals contact damage.

Name: Swarm Spider
Description: Very erratically hops toward Isaac in large groups, dealing contact damage.

Name: Swarmer
Description: Slowly floats around the room, spawning several Attack Flies . Spawns Pooters upon taking damage. Spawns a Boom Fly upon death.

Name: Swinger
Description: Slowly moves towards Isaac as its head swings around its base. Upon death, spawns a Maw or a Globin depending on which part is killed.

Name: Tainted Boom Fly
Description: Flies across the room in straight diagonal lines, dealing contact damage. Upon death, it glows brightly, warning that it is about to explode; this explosion sends 4 lines of further explosions in the cardinal directions, which span the length of the room.

Name: Tainted Faceless
Description: Wanders around the room, rarely firing a radial burst of six shots. Chases Isaac and fires shots very frequently after taking damage.

Name: Tainted Hopper
Description: Jumps and twirls around the room, shooting 4 rings of projectiles that increase in size with each shot.

Name: Tainted Mole
Description: Dig towards Isaac and release a ring of rock waves. Fires 3 blood shots at Isaac 4 times.

Name: Tainted Mulligan
Description: Wanders around the room, avoiding Isaac and spawning 6 Ring Flies if he gets close. Spawns a plethora of fly enemies upon death.

Name: Tainted Pooter
Description: Slowly drifts toward Isaac, occasionally firing four blood shots at him that split into two smaller ones when they hit a wall or obstacle.

Name: Tainted Round Worm
Description: Pops out of the ground in random locations alongside several tail ends. The head fires a large blood shot that splits into a radial burst of 8 blood shots, while the tail ends shoot normal blood shots.

Name: Tainted Soy Creep
Description: Slowly crawls along walls to try to line up with Isaac and shoots a 4 diagonal streams of Soy Milk shots.

Name: Tainted Spitty
Description: Slowly moves around the room, firing chaotic bursts of blood shots in all directions and occasionally spitting a line of blood shots in the direction it's facing. Fires two rotating rings of blood shots upon death.

Name: Tainted Sub Horf
Description: Will only shoot when hit. Takes heavy knockback and rotates when hit. Shoots a lot faster and has bigger projectiles than its normal variant.

Name: Tainted Sucker
Description: Flies slowly towards Isaac. Upon death, fires a radial burst of six blood shots that each also fires a radial burst of six blood shots.

Name: Tainted Tube Worm
Description: Pops out of the ground in random locations, spitting 4 explosive shots towards Isaac.

Name: Tar Boy
Description: Fires a short-ranged spray of shots that leave behind slowing Black Creep . Occasionally burrows underground and reappears under any pools of black creep in the room. If Isaac stands on the Creep, the Tar Boy can fire shots straight upwards out of the Creep underneath Isaac/ send out a tentacle underneath Isaac.

Name: Teleport Pitfall
Description: Invulnerable and stationary enemy which Isaac falls into when walked over, taking damage and popping back out at a random location after a short delay.

Name: The Thing
Description: Crawls along a wall and attempts to line up with Isaac, then spits a line of damaging Red Creep.

Name: Ticking Spider
Description: Crawls around the room erratically, following Isaac and dealing contact damage. Can jump small distances. Explodes upon death.

Name: Tinted Rock Spider
Description: Quickly crawls around the room. If it sees Isaac, it crawls at him, trying to deal contact damage. Turns into a Soul Heart upon death. Can only spawn by breaking tinted rocks on Mines or Ashpit .

Name: Triple Grimace
Description: Stationary and invulnerable monster that occasionally fires a triple shot at Isaac. Stops firing when room is cleared.

Name: Trite
Description: Quickly leaps towards Isaac and deals contact damage.

Name: Tube Worm
Description: Pops out of the ground in random locations and fires a long-range spray of arcing shots where Isaac will be.

Name: Tumor
Description: Moves around the room diagonally, occasionally firing 6 blood shots in all directions. Fires more often upon getting damaged.

Name: Twitchy
Description: Alternates between walking towards and rapidly leaping at Isaac, dealing contact damage. Can leap to Isaac's current position, or where Isaac is heading, and can also leap away to dodge incoming fire.

Name: Ulcer
Description: Pops out of the ground in random locations and spawns a Dart Fly if Isaac is in sight. Fires a blood shot after spawning 6 Dart Flies.

Name: Ultra Death Head
Description: Invulnerable enemy spawned by Ultra Death that moves across the room in a waving motion in large quantities as a part of one of his attacks. Dies upon the completion of the attack.

Name: Ultra Death Scythe
Description: Stays stationary for a moment, then travels in straight lines towards Ultra Death .

Name: Ultra Famine Fly
Description: Charges at Isaac at a delay. Deals contact damage. Spawned by Ultra Famine .

Name: Ultra Greed Coin (Bomb)
Description: Spins on itself and explodes with a large radius if not destroyed.

Name: Ultra Greed Coin (Heart)
Description: Spins on itself and heals Ultra Greed for 13.125 HP each if not destroyed.

Name: Ultra Greed Coin (Key)
Description: Spins on itself and opens a golden door around the room if not destroyed, spawning hordes of Greed Gapers .

Name: Ultra Greed Coin (Spinner)
Description: Spins around the room, dealing contact damage.

Name: Ultra Pestilence Fly
Description: Flies in swarms around Ultra Pestilence , blocking shots and dealing contact damage.

Name: Ultra Pestilence Fly Ball
Description: Floats towards Isaac, doing contact damage and spawning Ultra Pestilence Flies upon taking damage.

Name: Unborn
Description: Floats quickly towards Isaac, and occasionally teleports to another position near him.

Name: Vis
Description: Randomly wanders around the room. Pauses to charge and fire a Brimstone laser when Isaac gets in its line of sight.

Name: Vis Fatty
Description: Spawns with a Fetal Demon attached to it and slowly walks towards Isaac. Will occasionally fart, briefly pushing the demon away and spawning creep around itself and the demon. If the demon is killed first, the Fatty will shoot out Brimstone in the diagonal direction closest to Isaac. It will then fly around the room diagonally, bumping off of walls and tall blocks, all while continuously firing Brimstone behind it.

Name: Vis Versa
Description: Randomly wanders around the room. Pauses to charge and fire a homing Brimstone laser when Isaac gets in its line of sight.

Name: Visage Plasma
Description: Floats in diagonal directions, doing contact damage. Spawned by The Visage and used in its phase 3 attacks.

Name: Vomit Grimace
Description: Stationary and invulnerable monster that occasionally fires an Ipecac shot at Isaac. Stops firing when room is cleared.

Name: Walking Boil
Description: Does not shrink or regenerate. Walks around aimlessly and fires multiple short-ranged blood projectiles in random directions.

Name: Walking Gut
Description: Does not shrink or regenerate. Walks around aimlessly and fires Ipecac shots in random directions.

Name: Walking Sack
Description: Does not shrink or regenerate. Walks around aimlessly and occasionally spawns Spiders .

Name: Wall Creep
Description: Crawls along walls to try to line up with Isaac and shoots three blood shots in a line.

Name: Wall Hugger
Description: Moves around the room like Guts , damaging Isaac by contact. Cannot be destroyed.

Name: Whipper
Description: Runs around the room, sprinting at Isaac when he gets in its line of sight and lashing at him when it gets close.

Name: Willo
Description: Flies in a circle around Isaac (in formation with other Willos if available), keeping an exact distance away from him. One Willo at a time will occasionally light up and fire a shot at Isaac.

Name: Wizoob
Description: Disappears, then appears near Isaac and spits a cluster of spectral tears at him.

Name: Wraith
Description: Walks toward Isaac, dealing contact damage. They are invisible and can only be seen through the reflection they cast in the water, or the ripples they make as they walk.

Name: Wrinkly Baby
Description: Dashes towards Isaac at high speed and fires three blood shots in his direction once stopped.
